entities.summary: Christiana Abiodun Emanuel, born Abiodun Akinsowon (1907–1994), was a co-founder, along with Moses Orimolade Tunolase, of the Cherubim and Seraphim, an Aladura Christian denomination in Nigeria. After a schism in the church, she founded and led the Cherubim and Seraphim Society.
